primary_whole_readings.draft: Nimm frisches Wurzelmaterial; trockne und zerkleinere es für ein herzustellendes Ergebnis von einer Masseneinheit trockenem Pulver.
Spüle mit Wasser, bis das Material gereinigt ist; danach breite das Pflanzenmaterial dünn und gleichmäßig aus.
Trockne in der Sonne; vermahle grob; trenne mit einem Sieb den groben vom feinen Anteil.
Bewahre den feinen Anteil auf; bewahre den groben Anteil auf. Decke den groben Anteil mit einem Tuch ab; danach lagere diesen Rückstand getrennt.
Nimm das verfügbare Pulver; siebe, bis der gewonnene Pulveranteil fein und gereinigt ist und eine Masseneinheit umfasst.
Wurzelmaterial: zerkleinere es; trockne über Nacht im Schatten; danach durchmische die vorbereitete Gesamtmenge gründlich und gleichmäßig.
Im vorbereiteten Material: zwei Masseneinheiten grobes Mahlgut und eine Masseneinheit Pulver. Trenne diese Teile; hebe den vorhandenen groben Anteil heraus.
Sortiere diesen groben Anteil mit einem Sieb; bewahre eine Masseneinheit Faserstücke und eine Masseneinheit Körnchen auf.
Wasser und Öl sowie eine Masseneinheit des verfügbaren feinen Pulvers: verknete diese Zutaten zu einer Portion Paste.
Vermahle diese Paste mit dem bereits darin enthaltenen Wasser.

quantity_diagnostic_rival.scope: Same complete lexicon, source-owner references, disjoint partitions, exhaustive lossless SORT and all other constructions; change only the repeated quantity-run interpretation.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.changed_rule: Two adjacent daiin assert massQ twice of the same one material, instead of adding to2Q.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.local_written_consequence: The coarse material in f32v.8 then has Q, while its two disjoint stored products in f32v.9 each have Q; conservation requires Q=Q+Q, impossible for Q>0.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.decision: This repeated-assertion interpretation conflicts with the NEW common partition contract. It does not refute old P14 M, which did not assert this same partition and ownership graph.
escape_costs: Allow overlapping product descriptions rather than disjoint FIBRES/GRANULES fractions.
Allow an additional named or unnamed coarse input, gain of tracked plant solid, or nonexhaustive reassignment of .9 to another stock.
Change one or more fixed Q values.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.limits: Those would be different complete contracts. The two printed product names alone do not prove disjointness. No calibrated preference for the additive contract or decoded number follows.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.loss_robustness: The local contradiction does not require exact zero loss: with nonnegative loss L it would require Q=2Q+L, impossible for Q>0. No net addition of tracked plant solid remains essential.

quantity_individuals_rival.changed_rule: Each daiin in an adjacent run denotes its own allotted portion of the same material kind, each of massQ, rather than one 2Q portion. Other reference and transformation rules are unchanged.
quantity_individuals_rival.aggregate_consequence: The two coarse portions together still have2Q. SEPARATE groups all coarse material into its coarse branch while preserving the identities of any constituent portions. LIFT_OUT DEFINITE COARSE_FRACTION can therefore refer to that collective branch, and the same3Q balance remains possible.
quantity_individuals_rival.what_is_not_selected: The mass equation cannot distinguish one coarse portion2Q from a collective of two coarse portionsQ+Q. No claim that ADD has been selected over this allocation is justified.
quantity_individuals_rival.identity_cost: If COARSE_FRACTION were required to pick one indivisible portion, two equal candidates would cause an ambiguity and onlyQ would be active; that stricter singular reference is not a fact about the word and is not silently imposed. No later source group in this offer identifies either original portion individually.

frozen_global_effects.CRUSH: Eliminate uncomminuted material into coarse and/or fine sizes without increasing sizes already coarse/fine; preserve desired plant mass and enclosing carrier components. No mandatory positive amount in both size classes.
frozen_global_effects.GRIND: Act on the plant-solid constituent, monotonically toward equal or smaller particle size, preserving plant mass, water/oil component identities/amounts and an enclosing paste carrier. For c,p: c_next=c-a,p_next=p+a,0<=a<=c. If c=0, no coarse material is created. Changes within a size bin remain unmeasured.
frozen_global_effects.FORM_UPDATE: For a standalone solid, update form class from the resulting distribution: all-fine becomes a powder stock, coarse/fine mixture a prepared bulk. A whole paste remains PASTE while its plant constituent changes. Matching remains subject to free/contained access.
frozen_global_effects.DRY: Remove retained carrier water from the active preparation while preserving plant solid and oil; do not identify FINE with DRY.
frozen_global_effects.RINSE: Use the written water supply; preserve desired plant solid and particle grade, remove extraneous dirt as required by CLEAN. Retained water is bounded by previous water plus supply; any remainder is drainage, not newly created plant material.
frozen_global_effects.MIX: Redistribute current prepared bulk, no new ingredient or mass.
frozen_global_effects.SEPARATE_BY_GRADE: Free disjoint coarse and fine branches of the current bulk; positive masses come from the explicit written inventory/named outputs, not universal grinding.
frozen_global_effects.LIFT_OUT: Select and move the existing branch, no disposal.
frozen_global_effects.SORT: Partition selected input into the two explicitly named disjoint products. Feasibility of the physical sorting discriminator is an unverified condition; no universal common sieve cut is assumed.
frozen_global_effects.KEEP_COVER_STORE: Retain/select/cover/store existing material; preserve mass and identity.
frozen_global_effects.RETRIEVE: Select existing free compatible material; absence/tie fails.
frozen_global_effects.SIEVE: Create designated passing fraction plus disjoint unselected remainder; their combined plant mass equals input. Refining fine input may leave both outputs fine under the previous grade threshold. Zero unnamed remainder creates no node.
frozen_global_effects.KNEAD: Incorporate chosen powder and written W/O into one paste aggregate; components are retained but no longer free.
frozen_global_effects.WITH_MEDIUM: Use contained water as medium of the active aggregate; no input event.

common_relation.name: PARTITION_FRAME
constraints: Both branches have positive plant-solid mass where explicitly required by the written product inventory.
Branches are disjoint, exhaust x, and retain x ancestry.
Output predicates, masses and order are only the already-written fixed construction arguments.
A prospective branch reference allocates no physical material; event realization creates the branches once and retires the free parent whole.
Role matching uses semantic signatures and current clause scope; no form, folio or desired target value chooses the operator.
Only the unchanged V2 physical partition effects are permitted; no material, water or oil is created.

one_operator.definition: Conjoin the same PARTITION_FRAME relation with the unchanged base denotation placed at its typed role. Keep the old full-word denotation as an additional conjunct; no entry is replaced.

new_assumptions: Initial q is a constituent in the three exact paired forms.
The same explicit partition relation is contributed across three semantic input signatures.

Material lifting selects a partition-relative reference; event-modifier lifting creates a partition-event constraint; branch-action lifting distributes the unchanged action after creating the local partition. These are three declared type clauses, not three empirical discoveries.
The qotaiin old meaning is narrowed by a sieve requirement even where the written clause omits the adjunct.
The qotchy old meaning is narrowed by new partition creation followed by moving every written output to the work position in order.
No universal all-q writer is claimed: qotey remains unanalysed and unrepaired.

boundaries: No meanings confirmed; all65 values and15 aliases remain exploratory, with56 ZL singleton types.
The current three different input types have one paired root each; fit cannot empirically distinguish a typed general law from three tailored lifts.
No new grammar rules or target text; fixed18 schemas and all238 positions retained literally.
No complete morphology for qotey, and f4r remains closed incomplete.
Same tool kind is not same physical sieve cut: the two f32 partitions can need different unbound sorting parameters.
DRY_STATE boolean update remains unbound; no fine=dry or water-removal consequence.
No scalar probabilities, simulator, significance, blind test or experiment PASS.
decision: A root-name-free common partition restriction can be stated, with concrete new tool and subevent commitments. Exact unchanged full-denotation factorization is NOT obtained; retain at most as exploratory strengthening, not lexical compression or proof of q. No further target selected.
